objective: Investigate why Reports appear correctly for some Games such as Trend and Tap Assist but have historically been absent or inconsistent for other mature Games. Trace the current report-discovery pipeline from Game identity/root through report scanning/configuration and into the Sideline Reports UI. Determine: (1) what paths/patterns are actually scanned; (2) whether Games can provide Game-specific report configuration; (3) whether legacy/default patterns such as Docs REPORT differ from mature Games using REPORTS / Reports / Reports-SLC; (4) whether Game identity/root resolution can cause the discrepancy; (5) whether UI projection/filtering contributes; (6) the smallest truthful repair, if a defect is proven. Do not reorganize any mature Game. Do not fix the report-discovery issue during this reconnaissance; the objective is useful evidence only.
scope: Investigate exactly the objective stated above within this Game root.
Do not expand beyond the objective without new human authorization.
nonGoals: Do not modify, create, delete, or rename any Game file.
Do not execute shell commands or mutate git.
Do not implement a fix or redesign architecture during this reconnaissance.
Do not launch subagents or use network/browser/MCP tools beyond approved read-only reconnaissance.

allowed: Read and search inside the supplied Game workspace.
Return the report to the trusted Formation Dispatcher.
denied: Write, edit, create, delete, or rename Game files.
Broaden the bounded objective without new authorization.
Use network, MCP, browser, or subagent tools beyond the approved Scout tool set.

evidenceContract: Cite exact Game-relative paths and exact function/symbol names where applicable.
